magnetScoop.desc: Every node you enter pays 2 scrap, and every battle you win pays 3 more.

grapple.name: Grapnel Hook
grapple.desc: +3 scrap for every enemy you kill, and 8 scrap more for a battle won by the end of turn 3.

lotteryBlock.name: Lottery Block
lotteryBlock.desc: The first reroll in every shop is free, and every third node you enter pays 12 scrap.

trainingModule.name: Training Module
trainingModule.desc: +20% XP, and after 4 nodes the drilled crew adds 1 reroll to every battle.

assayRig.name: Assay Rig
assayRig.desc: A max face resolved in Weapon A is assayed for 5 scrap.

brokerLink.name: Broker Link
brokerLink.desc: Shop prices −16%, but the antenna array eats 3 max hull.

slagPress.name: Slag Press
slagPress.desc: A die placed in Weapon B on its lowest face is pressed up to 4 and pays 3 scrap.

tithePlate.name: Tithe Plate
tithePlate.desc: +25% scrap from every source, and 2 scrap at battle start for each [scrap] item you own.

salvageArm.name: Salvage Arm
salvageArm.desc: Every battle won logs a wreck; from the fifth wreck on, each node you enter pays 4 scrap.

auditCore.name: Audit Core
auditCore.desc: +4 scrap at the start of every battle, and 8 more once the Reactor is Mk2.

mirrorPlate.name: Mirror Plating
mirrorPlate.desc: Every second die resolved in a shield mount throws 6 damage back at the end of the turn.

ballastModule.name: Ballast Tanks
ballastModule.desc: Hull +5 and dodge −6% / glancing −3%; every node you enter repairs 1 hull.

escapePod.name: Escape Pod
escapePod.desc: Once per run you survive a lethal hit at 1 hull, and any battle entered under 40% hull opens with 8 shield and one more reserve slot.

heatsink.name: Heatsink
heatsink.desc: Any die fits the reactor over its cap for 1 hull, and a max face in the reactor vents 3 shield.

fieldStabilizer.name: Field Stabiliser
fieldStabilizer.desc: Interference tide hits one level softer, and a battle that opens at tide 3 or more hands you a free nudge and 4 shield.

ablativeWeave.name: Ablative Weave
ablativeWeave.desc: The first two dice resolved in Shields each battle add 5 shield each as the weave burns away.

bulkheadRing.name: Bulkhead Ring
bulkheadRing.desc: Hull +8 and dodge −6% / glancing −3%; with Shields at Mk 2 every battle opens with 6 shield, and at Mk 3 the reserve holds one more die.

dampingCoil.name: Damping Coil
dampingCoil.desc: The coil unwinds over the next three turns, ending each of them with 3 more shield.

hardpointClamp.name: Hardpoint Clamp
hardpointClamp.desc: Dodge +6% and glancing +3%, and once the engine mount reaches Mk 2 every die in it counts +3.

voidLiner.name: Void Liner
voidLiner.desc: +4 to every die in Shields II, and while hull is under 40% dice in Shields also add 4 shield.

siegeMount.name: Siege Mount
siegeMount.desc: +4 in Weapons A from the second turn on.

piercer.name: Piercer
piercer.desc: The first hit each battle ignores shields, and the Spinal Mount deals 2 extra damage for each Pierce item you carry.

emberInjector.name: Ember Injector
emberInjector.desc: Every die that resolves in Weapons B applies Burn 2.

railCradle.name: Rail Cradle
railCradle.desc: The Spinal Mount gains +1, and +5 in total once it is refitted to Mk II.

targetingMesh.name: Targeting Mesh
targetingMesh.desc: Marks are worth +1, and resolving Sensors adds +2 to the die waiting in Weapons A.

overpressure.name: Overpressure
overpressure.desc: The first slot resolved each turn gets +4 if it is a weapon; you reroll one die fewer.

ricochetHousing.name: Ricochet Housing
ricochetHousing.desc: Overkill carries into the next enemy, and a max face in Weapons B ricochets for 5 damage at the end of the next turn.

splinterHead.name: Splinter Head
splinterHead.desc: A weapon die under 4 deals 1 extra damage for each Swarm item you carry.

lanceCapacitor.name: Lance Capacitor
lanceCapacitor.desc: Each weapon die that resolves with 6 or more charge banked spends 6 of it for +5.

executioner.name: Executioner
executioner.desc: Once Weapons A is Mk II a max face there crits; at Mk III every shot from it adds 4 damage.

solenoid.name: Solenoid
solenoid.desc: One extra reroll every turn, and a die dropped into Weapon B below 4 is re-cocked once.

gyroStabilizer.name: Gyro Stabiliser
gyroStabilizer.desc: Reserve +1 die, and +1 more once the Engines are Mk2.

recycler.name: Recycler
recycler.desc: At the end of every turn it melts down every temporary die, casts a fresh grey d4 into the tray, and yields 2 scrap.

resonator.name: Resonator
resonator.desc: +2 charge at battle start per completed four-set, 2 more charge on each of the next three turns, and +2 to every die while you hold 8 or more charge.

nudgeGovernor.name: Nudge Governor
nudgeGovernor.desc: Nudges cost 1 less charge, but the charge cap drops by 1.

wideGrip.name: Wide Grip
wideGrip.desc: Reroll one more die at a time; with three items tagged «reroll», every battle adds one more die per reroll and one extra reroll.

capacitorBank.name: Capacitor Bank
capacitorBank.desc: Charge cap +3; a battle that ends with 3 or more charge banks 3 of it, and the bank pays those 3 back at the start of the next battle.

primerCoil.name: Primer Coil
primerCoil.desc: A die that resolves on its highest face in Sensors primes the next red die of the turn for +3.

growthTrellis.name: Growth Trellis
growthTrellis.desc: Growing dice climb one step higher, and a die that resolves on its highest face in Engines grows 1 more, up to 3.

echoBuffer.name: Echo Buffer
echoBuffer.desc: A die that repeats last turn's value stores 2 charge, and a die resolved in the Reactor gives 3 more charge on the next turn.

seedVault.name: Seed Vault
seedVault.desc: A temporary green d4 and a grey d4 join the tray for the first three turns of every battle.

jamBreaker.name: Jam Breaker
jamBreaker.desc: Your jam cuts 2 more from enemy attacks, and with Sensors at Mk2 or better every battle opens with one extra reserve slot.

entropySink.name: Entropy Sink
entropySink.desc: Charge cap +2, and with the Reactor at Mk2 or better any min face stores 3 charge.

paradoxLoop.name: Paradox Loop
paradoxLoop.desc: Weapon A resolves twice on a max face; Weapon B resolves twice on a min face.

blackLedger.name: Black Ledger
blackLedger.desc: Every node pays 3 scrap on credit; on the sixth node the ledger collects 4 hull and opens a new page.

prismLens.name: Prism Lens
prismLens.desc: Every die that rolls its lowest face is rolled again.

hushAntenna.name: Hush Antenna
hushAntenna.desc: End a turn with no charge banked and the antenna quietly returns 3 charge.

coldLogicCore.name: Cold Logic Core
coldLogicCore.desc: Nudges cost 2 less charge and every battle opens with 2 free nudges; crits never fire.

gamblersChip.name: Gambler's Chip
gamblersChip.desc: A max face pays 2 scrap for every [risk] item you own and rerolls a random other die.

bufferCells.name: Buffer Cells
bufferCells.desc: Hull −3, but every battle opens with 6 shield.

citadelCore.name: Citadel Core
citadelCore.desc: Any die fits a shield mount over its cap for no hull, every battle opens with 2 shield per Shieldwall item you carry, and while you hold 12 or more shield each die resolved in a shield mount repairs 3 hull.

ratchetFeed.name: Ratchet Feed
ratchetFeed.desc: A die dropped into Weapon A below 3 ratchets up to 3.

bondedVault.name: Bonded Vault
bondedVault.desc: +2 charge cap, and 1 charge at battle start for each [scrap] item you own.

foundryCore.name: Foundry Core
foundryCore.desc: +30% scrap and shop prices −12%; every battle starts with a minted yellow d6 that lasts 3 turns, and with a second one if you own 5 or more [scrap] items.

gunCamera.name: Gun Camera
gunCamera.desc: It films every node you enter: weapons get +2 after 6 nodes and +4 after 14.

autoloader.name: Autoloader Array
autoloader.desc: An extra red d6 joins your tray every battle, and every third weapon slot resolved racks another one for the next turn.

prophecyMount.name: Prophecy Mount
prophecyMount.desc: A max face in Weapon A sets the next grey die of that turn to its highest face.

phantomBay.name: Phantom Bay
phantomBay.desc: At the end of every turn a phantom grey d4 phases into the tray and lasts one turn.

delayLine.name: Delay Line
delayLine.desc: A max face in Weapon B arrives late: 3 damage per [spike] item you own lands at the end of the next turn.

nonEuclidRack.name: Non-Euclidean Rack
nonEuclidRack.desc: Every slot accepts a die of any tier at 1 hull each time it resolves; charge cap −3.

sting.name: Sting
sting.desc: +1 on a max face in weapons.

echo.name: Echo
echo.desc: Repeating last turn's value stores 1 charge and adds +1.

anchor.name: Anchor
anchor.desc: This die can never be locked.

flame.name: Flame
flame.desc: The first weapon die each turn adds Burn 2.

edge.name: Edge
edge.desc: Rerolling this die alone costs nothing.

shade.name: Shade
shade.desc: +1 when it resolves in the reactor.

spring.name: Spring
spring.desc: One free nudge on this die each battle.

spark.name: Spark
spark.desc: A rolled 1 stores 2 charge and the die is set to 2.

bastion.name: Bastion
bastion.desc: 6 or more in shields grants 2 shield.

hunger.name: Hunger
hunger.desc: A max face deals 1 extra damage to the target.

ash.name: Ash
ash.desc: A min face pays 2 scrap and adds Burn 1.

surf.name: Surf
surf.desc: On the first turn in engines: +3 and 2 shield.

weight.name: Weight
weight.desc: When placed, any value under 3 becomes 3 at the cost of 1 hull.

thorn.name: Thorn
thorn.desc: 5 or more in weapons adds Burn 1.

glass.name: Glass
glass.desc: +2 in weapons; a max face costs 1 hull.

rime.name: Rime
rime.desc: +2 shield whenever it fills a shield slot; while you hold 8 or more shield, 1 more at end of turn.

loam.name: Loam
loam.desc: Every time it fills engines it grows +1, up to +3.

mint.name: Mint
mint.desc: A max face pays 3 scrap; a won battle pays 5 more.

pin.name: Pin
pin.desc: In sensors any value under 5 counts as 5; a max face there stores 2 charge.

drum.name: Drum
drum.desc: Filling the reactor stores 2 charge and beats the drum; from the third beat on, 2 more charge at end of turn.

scale.name: Scale
scale.desc: A max face in shields heals 1 hull and grants 2 shield.

beaconRune.name: Beacon
beaconRune.desc: Resolving in sensors primes your next red die for +3.

rust.name: Rust
rust.desc: 8 or more in weapons may exceed the slot cap for 1 hull.

salt.name: Salt
salt.desc: A max face grants 2 shield and corrodes 1 hull.

glimmer.name: Glimmer
glimmer.desc: Placing it under 3 stores 1 charge and pays 1 scrap.

sinew.name: Sinew
sinew.desc: 4 or more in engines grants 1 shield and 1 charge.

cipher.name: Cipher
cipher.desc: Repeating last turn's value pays 4 scrap and stores 1 charge.

brand.name: Brand
brand.desc: +3 in weapons for a red die, +1 for any other.

tidepool.name: Tidepool
tidepool.desc: A min face in shields grants 3 shield; while the interference tide is 2 or higher, 2 more shield at end of turn.

voidmark.name: Voidmark
voidmark.desc: A min face in the reactor stores 3 charge; while you hold 8 or more charge it also gains +2 there.

pyre.name: Pyre
pyre.desc: In weapons it adds Burn 1, and gains +2 there while you own 2 or more [Burn] items.

swarmMark.name: Swarm Mark
swarmMark.desc: In weapons: +2 while you own 3 or more [Swarm] items, and a max face deals 1 extra damage per [Swarm] item you own.

seventhFace.name: Seventh Face
seventhFace.desc: The die gains a seventh outcome on its highest face: the first max face each turn resolves its slot a second time.

mirrorFace.name: Mirror Face
mirrorFace.desc: The die gains a seventh outcome on its highest face: on a max roll your lowest die gains +3 and you store 1 charge.

sleeve.name: Sleeve
sleeve.desc: If you own 2 or more [Reroll] items, every battle starts with one extra reroll.

tuningFork.name: Tuning Fork
tuningFork.desc: +2 while you hold 5 or more charge; placing it stores 1 charge if you own 2 or more [Charge] items.

tickMark.name: Tick Mark
tickMark.desc: Placed in the reactor, it schedules 3 charge and 2 shield for next turn.

ledgerMark.name: Ledger Mark
ledgerMark.desc: In sensors it pays 2 scrap, and gains +3 there while you own 2 or more [Scrap] items.

glacis.name: Glacis
glacis.desc: +3 in shields while you own 2 or more [Shieldwall] items; while you hold 6 or more shield, heal 1 hull at end of turn.

lifeline.name: Lifeline
lifeline.desc: In the repair bay it heals 2 hull and grants 2 shield.

fate.severance: Severance — the line to your own luck goes dead.
fate.misfire: Misfire — something in the hull answers wrong.
fate.interference: Interference — the sector eats your margins.
fate.trade: Trade — the Rim takes hull and gives back current.
fate.wash: Wash — nothing gained, nothing lost. Almost.
fate.ripple: Ripple — the field folds neatly around you.
fate.tailwind: Tailwind — the sector leans your way for once.
fate.cache: Cache — a dead crew's savings, unclaimed.
fate.volley: Volley — the numbers decide to be a weapon.
fate.mercy: Mercy — the Rim mends what it broke.
fate.miracle: Miracle — for one turn the sector is on your side.

dossier.scavDrone: Somebody's cargo loader, taught two commands and let loose.
dossier.raider: Clan colours painted over clan colours. Nobody remembers the first ones.
dossier.shieldWarden: Fleet escort doctrine, still running forty years after the fleet.
dossier.mine: Cheap, patient, and entirely without opinions.
dossier.jammerCorvette: Built to blind customs cutters. It never learned a second job.
dossier.leechSkiff: It does not want your hull. It wants your dice to sit still.
dossier.choirZealot: Sings on an open channel so you know the odds are being prayed at.
dossier.riftWasp: Dies loudly and leaves a slot ringing.
dossier.bountyHuntress: She keeps a ledger. You are a line in it, not a grudge.
dossier.raiderAlpha: The one whose turret still tracks. That is the whole promotion.
dossier.breakerDrone: Salvage tooling with the safeties filed off.
dossier.magnetTug: It cannot shoot. It does not need to; it can hold.
dossier.minelayer: Lays its field, then waits to be the least interesting thing here.
dossier.riftling: A shape the Rift keeps redrawing because it likes the first draft.
dossier.echoShade: Whatever you just did, it heard the loud half.
dossier.unstableCore: A reactor that never finished deciding whether to stop.
dossier.choirAcolyte: Volunteered. That is the frightening part.
dossier.hymnTurret: A gun tuned to a chord. It fires on the downbeat.
dossier.zealotRam: No shields, no plan past the first thirty seconds.
dossier.coreFragment: A piece of the Core that still thinks it is the whole.
dossier.probabilityKnot: Two futures tied together and pulled tight.
dossier.nullDrone: It removes options rather than hull. Efficient, in its way.
dossier.hookTug: It bills for the tow whether or not you asked.
dossier.slagHauler: Slow, armoured, full of somebody else's ship.
dossier.chaffSwarm: Individually harmless. That is the joke, and it lands.
dossier.foldWorm: It eats the certainty out of a number and leaves the digit.
dossier.nullEcho: Half of your last turn, played back with worse intentions.
dossier.riftAnchor: It holds a piece of space still so the rest can wobble.
dossier.hymnCantor: Sets the tempo. Kill the tempo first.
dossier.pyreDeacon: Heals its choir and calls it mercy. It is, from one side.
dossier.reliquary: A hull built around a relic nobody has opened in decades.
dossier.causalityLoop: It swaps two of your numbers and lets you do the rest.
dossier.voidWarden: Older than the Choir. Possibly older than the fleet.
dossier.quietEngine: It does not attack. It makes the room uncertain.
dossier.hullGnat: Too small to matter, in numbers large enough to matter.
dossier.clanBreaker: The clan's collector. It bills in hull and takes the change.
dossier.riftTyrant: It grew an eye so the Rift could watch back.
dossier.choirCantor: It leads the hymn, and the hymn is a weapon.
dossier.coreSentinel: The Core keeps one of these where the causality is thin.
dossier.leechPrince: Every skiff in the field learned its trade from this one.
dossier.mineBaron: It seeds the field, then charges for safe passage through it.
dossier.convoyAlpha: Three escorts and a hull that will not die until they do.
dossier.wardenFragment: A piece of the Warden that never got the stand-down order.
dossier.leechQueen: She takes the dice first and the ship at leisure.
dossier.mineTyrant: It thinks of the whole field as one weapon. It is right.
dossier.choirHerald: Sent ahead to be survived, so the Flagship is understood.
dossier.mirrorHull: It answers with your own last turn, halved and honest.
dossier.quarantineWarden: Still enforcing a quarantine on a sector with nothing to protect.
dossier.breakerBarge: It eats salvage. Your scrap counts as salvage.
dossier.riftMaw: Not a ship. A place that decided to have a direction.
dossier.choirFlagship: The hymn, given a hull and a firing solution.
dossier.coreHeart: The thing the fleet came to study. It has been studying back.
dossier.anchorHulk: Mooring plate welded over mooring plate until nothing small could ever matter to it.
dossier.tetherDrone: It does not shoot the ship. It marks the dice, and lets arithmetic do the rest.
dossier.salvageWarden: Fleet triage doctrine with nobody left to triage. It patches whatever is still flying.
dossier.scrapKite: Built to die in front of you, loudly, with your scrap in its claws.
dossier.convoyShell: Convoy doctrine reduced to one rule: the shell is last, always.
dossier.tollBarge: It does not want you dead. It wants a cut, and it will take it out of your hull if you argue.
dossier.ripperTug: A tow rig with no cargo left to tow. It pulls harder the longer you let it.
dossier.mineTender: It lays the field, and when it dies the field armours itself out of the wreck.
dossier.capWraith: It does not break the die. It just makes the die smaller for a while, which is worse.
dossier.slotMirror: It reads the deck census the way a gunner reads a range card.
dossier.paradoxHusk: Whatever was inside finished happening. The husk is still working through the order.
dossier.riftWidow: It never fights alone, and it never really dies alone either.
dossier.antiphonChoir: Two voices calling a third. The web does not thin, it grows.
dossier.censerDrone: It swings wide, and the smoke it leaves shuts doors you needed.
dossier.litanyWarden: A gate of hymn. Small shots are prayers it has already heard.
dossier.martyrThurible: It is not meant to survive the encounter. It is meant to armour the ones that do.
dossier.echoOfTheHeart: A valve that outlived its heart, still closing on schedule.
dossier.retrocausalMote: It arrives already dead and spends the fight catching up to that.
dossier.stormChanter: It waits until you are hurt, because a storm is only worth calling when it lands.
dossier.causalWard: It does not stop the shot. It decides which shots were ever going to count.
dossier.slagGolem: Poured, not built. There is no single place on it worth hitting hard.
dossier.tollmaster: It does not read your dice. It reads your hesitation, and it charges for it.
dossier.brineSiphon: Salvage rig retooled to drink the one resource nobody armours.
dossier.capacitorWraith: It was a reactor once, and it still remembers what a full charge tastes like.
dossier.blightVine: It grows on whatever you grew. That is the entire relationship.
dossier.bailiff: Somebody's collections routine, still serving papers on a dead sector.
dossier.dragnet: It never aims at the ship. It reaches into the tray and decides for you.
dossier.resonator: It was built to tune a fleet. Nothing changed except who is being tuned.
dossier.quarantineTwin: Two hulls on one clock. Break the clock, not the hulls.
dossier.usurer: It keeps offering. That is not mercy, that is the terms.
dossier.silencer: The field it holds is the same signal a sensor jam breaks. Nobody told it.
dossier.coreSliver: A chip off something larger, still keeping one colour out at a time.
dossier.beaconTrap: It answers every hail. That is how they get you close enough for the lenses.
dossier.auctionCorvette: The Breakers' other doctrine: buy the wreck before you make it.
dossier.riftBranch: A limb of the Choir that grew through the rift and came out wrong.
dossier.cantorColossus: One voice where the Flagship brought a hundred. It is louder.
dossier.mirrorHeart: The Core learned to read a deck. This is what it built from the reading.
dossier.retroEcho: It is not a scan of you. It is the last minute of you, played back at the volume you chose. Quiet turns are cheap out here.
dossier.foldWraith: The crews that met one described the same thing: firing before aiming, and being right anyway.
dossier.slowStrider: Nothing about it is fast. That is the point: it wins the fights that last, and it never starts a short one.
dossier.oddsEater: It does not want your ship. It wants the die you were saving, and it can tell which one that is.
dossier.causalSplinter: Killing it is the trigger. Everything past the Core has learned to charge for its own death.
dossier.preEcho: It arrives before the fleet it belongs to. There is no fleet. There has not been one for forty years.
dossier.hushHerald: It does not attack the ship. It attacks the list of things the ship is allowed to do.
dossier.paradoxLoom: Something is being woven. The Keeper says it is a name. The Keeper says a great many things.
dossier.foldTyrant: It rules a stretch of space three rows wide where the word «after» has no fixed meaning.
dossier.hushWarden: A door with opinions. It decides which of your systems were ever really yours.
dossier.theHush: The forty years of silence had a shape, and this is it. It does not kill you. It subtracts you.
dossier.echoFleet: Five ships you already sank, remembered well enough to sink you back.

keeper.mara1: Mara: «Everything here works. Define 'works' first, though.»
keeper.mara2: Mara: «No refunds, no receipts, no hard feelings.»
keeper.mara3: Mara: «You look like a captain who counts. I like that. Slightly.»
keeper.mara4: Mara: «Prices are firm. The stock is not.»
keeper.mara5: Mara: «I sold that one twice. The first buyer never came back for it.»
keeper.mara6: Mara: «Buy the ugly one. The ugly ones survive.»
keeper.mara7: Mara: «If it rolls, it sells. If it argues, it's yours.»
keeper.mara8: Mara: «Don't touch the shelf. That shelf is inventory.»
keeper.mara9: Mara: «Half the Rim owes me. You're the half that pays.»
keeper.mara10: Mara: «Sell me the ones you're afraid of. I'm not.»
keeper.mara11: Mara: «I've stopped asking where the cargo came from. Saves time.»
keeper.mara12: Mara: «That's fleet stock. Which means it works and nobody wants it.»
keeper.mara13: Mara: «You want cheap or you want to come back? Pick one.»
keeper.mara14: Mara: «I don't haggle. I reconsider, occasionally.»
keeper.mara15: Mara: «Business is steady. Everyone out here needs something twice.»
keeper.mara16: Mara: «Take it. If it kills you, I'll buy it back from the wreck.»
keeper.yusuf1: Yusuf: «Bring it in. We'll see what's still yours.»
keeper.yusuf2: Yusuf: «Nothing's beyond repair. Some things are beyond payment.»
keeper.yusuf3: Yusuf: «You fly like someone who's read the manual once.»
keeper.yusuf4: Yusuf: «I can fix the hull. The habits are on you.»
keeper.yusuf5: Yusuf: «My father welded this bay. It's outlived his lane.»
keeper.yusuf6: Yusuf: «Upgrade the thing you actually use. Radical advice, I know.»
keeper.yusuf7: Yusuf: «Fusion's clean work. Two of a kind, one better.»
keeper.yusuf8: Yusuf: «Voucher's good here. It's good anywhere I say it is.»
keeper.yusuf9: Yusuf: «You want speed or you want to arrive?»
keeper.yusuf10: Yusuf: «Every convoy I've lost, I lost to a system I skipped.»
keeper.yusuf11: Yusuf: «I don't ask about the scorch marks. I just weld over them.»
keeper.yusuf12: Yusuf: «Rest here as long as you like. The Rim isn't going anywhere.»
keeper.yusuf13: Yusuf: «Cheap repairs cost twice. You'll learn that once.»
keeper.yusuf14: Yusuf: «Go on then. Don't make me see this hull again.»
keeper.keeper1: The Keeper: «You're the third ship this cycle. The other two didn't stop.»
keeper.keeper2: The Keeper: «I keep the lights. Somebody has to say where the edges are.»
keeper.keeper3: The Keeper: «The fleet passed here singing. That's in the log.»
keeper.keeper4: The Keeper: «Beacons don't guide. They witness.»
keeper.keeper5: The Keeper: «I've stopped counting years. I count relights.»
keeper.keeper6: The Keeper: «Answer the beacons and the sector answers back. Eventually.»
keeper.keeper7: The Keeper: «Take the reading. Don't take the lamp.»
keeper.keeper8: The Keeper: «Everything the Rim swallows, a beacon saw first.»
keeper.keeper9: The Keeper: «I was crew once. The ship is still out there, technically.»
keeper.keeper10: The Keeper: «If you get to the Core, tell it somebody kept the lights on.»
keeper.mara17: «Everything on this side of the counter is priced. Everything on my side is not for sale.»
keeper.mara18: «Do not tell me what it does. Tell me what it did to the last hull that ran it.»
keeper.mFriend1: «You again. Good. I hate explaining my stock twice to strangers.»
keeper.mFriend2: «I set two things aside. Not a discount — an order of looking.»
keeper.mFriend3: «Nothing owed either way. That is rarer out here than the stock is.»
keeper.mGrudge1: «Look all you like. Touch nothing you have not counted out first.»
keeper.mGrudge2: «I remember the number. You remember the number. Let us not discuss it.»
keeper.mGrudge3: «You owe me and you robbed me. Pick one to fix and I will pretend the other did not happen.»
keeper.mDebt1: «Interest is not personal. It is just the only part of this that never sleeps.»
keeper.mDebt2: «You are into me for the price of a good reactor. I am not worried. Yet.»
keeper.mFavor1: «You flew that lane clean. Ask me for something before I change my mind about you.»
keeper.mVault1: «The bay is empty now. Feels bigger than it did full, somehow.»
keeper.mCourt1: «The court's fair-price ruling came through ahead of you. Congratulations, I suppose.»
keeper.mCourier1: «Your courier's route came out of the dark last week. Half the Rim is eating because of that.»
keeper.yusuf15: «Every weld I lay out here is temporary. Every one of them has held so far.»
keeper.yusuf16: «I do not ask where the parts came from. I ask what they were doing when they came off.»
keeper.yFriend1: «Sit. The kettle is a torch and the tea is terrible, but sit.»
keeper.yFriend2: «You have never once made this harder than it had to be. I notice that.»
keeper.yGrudge1: «I will do the work. The work is not the problem.»
keeper.yGrudge2: «Cash first. I did not use to say that to anybody.»
keeper.yShared1: «People stopped whispering after you put it on the open channel. That was worth something.»
keeper.yKept1: «You are still holding it. I am not going to ask you again — but I am counting.»
keeper.yLost1: «There is nothing left to argue about. You made sure of that.»
keeper.yAnswered1: «Nineteen hulls logged your transponder. Nineteen. I checked twice.»
keeper.yLane1: «The lane is still open. People are still coming through it. That is your weld, not mine.»
keeper.yLaneShut1: «They paid you and they got through. I am trying to hold both of those in one hand.»
keeper.keeper11: «A beacon is a promise somebody kept after they stopped being paid for it.»
keeper.keeper12: «Do not fix a relay you do not intend to come back to.»
keeper.keeper13: «The chain does not care in what order you light it. It only counts.»
keeper.keeper14: «Forty years is not a long time for a beacon. It is a long time for a person.»
keeper.kTrust1: «I have started routing you the hard ones. Take that as it was meant.»
keeper.kRepaid1: «We are square. I have filed it. It stays filed.»
keeper.kSlighted1: «I am still speaking to you, which should tell you how thin my options are.»
keeper.kSlighted2: «You took what you took. I am not going to make a speech about it.»
keeper.kBroken1: «One of mine went dark on your heading. I am not accusing. I am stating.»
keeper.kRebuilt1: «That relay is transmitting again. I heard it before I heard about you.»
keeper.kLit1: «The lighthouse is burning. I stopped expecting that about thirty years ago.»
keeper.kKey1: «You still have my key. Use it or send it back — either is an answer.»
keeper.kThree1: «Three. It has not been three since before you were built.»
keeper.kFive1: «Five. All of them. Say nothing for a moment, I want to listen.»
keeper.bMara1: You are not supposed to be able to buy anything here, captain. Neither am I. Let us both keep quiet.
keeper.bMara2: The hull you bought off me back there is still holding. That is the nicest thing I have said all year.
keeper.bMara3: You stripped a yard that had already stopped existing. I respect the thoroughness.
keeper.bYusuf1: Past the Core the convoy discipline is the only thing that still works. Keep your lane.
keeper.bYusuf2: You answered them. Forty years of nobody answering, and you did.
keeper.bYusuf3: You shut the signal down. Some of us needed to hear it. Some of us needed it to stop.
keeper.bKeeper1: You crossed. Then the only advice left is the old one: do not lean.
keeper.bKeeper2: You stood in it and did not fill it. Very few do.
keeper.bKeeper3: You spoke into it. It has your voice now. It is patient with voices.
keeper.bKeeper4: Balance is not a virtue out here. It is a frequency. Hold it and something answers.
keeper.bKeeper5: You picked a side at the last door. That is allowed. It is just not the only door.
keeper.bKeeper6: You walked past the beacon without touching it. So did the fleet. Look how that went.

signature.scavDrone: Three cheap taps, then one heavier — the sector's metronome.
signature.raider: Below 40% hull it stops shielding and swings twice instead.
signature.shieldWarden: If you are shielded it takes 5 of that shield; if not, it armours the pack for 6.
signature.jammerCorvette: Shuts one slot, and two at once from turn 4.
signature.leechSkiff: Locks the die you rolled highest, every other turn.
signature.choirZealot: Charges itself: its next hit lands doubled.
signature.riftWasp: Killing it welds your main gun shut for a turn.
signature.anchorHulk: Raises a gate at 5: anything under it is absorbed whole, and a mark reads straight past.
signature.tetherDrone: Curses a tray die: −2 to its face for two turns.
signature.salvageWarden: Heals the pack for 4, and heals it again for 5 when it dies.
signature.breakerDrone: Swings wide for 8 while you have no shield; against a shield it spreads instead.
signature.magnetTug: Every hit that lands takes 5 scrap with it, on top of its own theft beat.
signature.minelayer: Lays a mine unless the field is already crowded — at three bodies it shoots instead.
signature.hookTug: Reads your reactor: at 5 charge or more it drains 4 instead of attacking.
signature.slagHauler: Re-plates for 8 while bare, and swings for 9 once it is plated.
signature.scrapKite: Spreads across a shield, dives for 7 into bare hull, and dying takes 6 scrap with it.
signature.convoyShell: Untouchable while an escort still flies — and once it is alone it stops walling and swings for 9.
signature.tollBarge: Names a price each cycle: 5 scrap, or 8 damage.
signature.ripperTug: From turn 4 it stops attacking and permanently adds 2 to every hit it makes.
signature.mineTender: Lays mines, and its wreck armours everything still alive for 6.
signature.riftling: A weighted coin between shrinking a slot cap and twisting a die down.
signature.echoShade: Returns half of whatever you dealt last turn.
signature.unstableCore: Kill it politely — it goes off for 6.
signature.foldWorm: Each cycle it twists a die down to the worse of two rolls.
signature.nullEcho: Below half hull it mirrors your last turn; above it, it just twists a die.
signature.riftAnchor: Pins a slot one tier smaller for as long as it lives.
signature.capWraith: Curses a tray die for −3 over two turns.
signature.slotMirror: Hits for the size of your deepest single school — a mono deck feeds it.
signature.paradoxHusk: Swaps your extremes, then storms the tray from turn 3.
signature.riftWidow: Calls a wasp each cycle, and its death curses your best die for −3.
signature.choirAcolyte: Heals the whole choir for 4: kill it first or kill nothing.
signature.hymnTurret: Weighted between charging itself and walling the pack for 4.
signature.zealotRam: Rams for 10 and pays 2 of its own hull; below half it rams for 12 and pays 3.
signature.hymnCantor: With an ally alive it charges; alone it just swings for 8.
signature.pyreDeacon: Heals the choir for 5, and its death charges everything still alive.
signature.reliquary: Untouchable while a single other voice still flies, and it heals the choir for 5 each cycle.
signature.antiphonChoir: Calls a fresh acolyte every third turn: the web regrows.
signature.censerDrone: Shuts two slots at once, once every cycle.
signature.litanyWarden: A gate at 6 over a heal: nothing small gets through, and what does get through it undoes.
signature.martyrThurible: Cheap, fast, and its death armours the choir for 8.
signature.coreFragment: Immune while anything else still flies, and once it is alone it swings for 10 instead of shielding.
signature.probabilityKnot: A weighted coin between swapping your extremes and storming the tray.
signature.nullDrone: Cheap and constant: one slot shut every cycle.
signature.causalityLoop: Swaps your high and low first, then volleys 6×3 into the mess.
signature.voidWarden: Locks a die, then swings for 10 while it is gone.
signature.quietEngine: Storms the tray once a cycle: two dice drift by one.
signature.echoOfTheHeart: The body is untouchable while its valve lives, and the valve re-plates for 6 each turn.
signature.retrocausalMote: Dying early is the plan: everything still alive gets charged.
signature.stormChanter: Below 40% hull it storms the tray; above it, it walls the pack for 5.
signature.causalWard: A gate at 6, then it takes 6 of the shield you raised against it.
signature.mine: One point of damage, and it is already where you were going.
signature.sparkMote: Two points of damage and no other opinions.
signature.breachDrone: Kills for 5 and pays 4 more on the way out.
signature.hullGnat: Two small volleys and a single 4: filler with a pulse.
signature.chaffSwarm: Four hits of 2, forever, until something kills it.
signature.raiderAlpha: The only raider that improvises: two of its three beats are weighted draws, and the turret adds 2 to every hit.
signature.bountyHuntress: Locks your highest die mid-volley, and the scope locks another every third turn.
signature.clanBreaker: Anti-economy: every landed hit takes 6 scrap, and the claw keeps taking it after the body stops.
signature.riftTyrant: Shrinks a slot cap on its own beat and twists a die every turn until the eye is dead.
signature.choirCantor: Heals the pack for 6 and charges every ally on every third turn.
signature.coreSentinel: Swaps your extremes, then re-plates itself for 6 every turn the lattice holds.
signature.leechPrince: Anti-tray: a die leaves the tray on its beat and another on the siphon's, every single turn.
signature.mineBaron: Lays a mine every cycle, the rack lays another every fourth turn, and the wreck goes off for 8.
signature.slagGolem: Anti-spike: no single hit lands above 8, and the mass re-plates for 6 each turn. Spread, or leave.
signature.tollmaster: Anti-reroll: every reroll you confirm charges it, and the ledger adds 2 to the hit it charges.
signature.brineSiphon: Anti-shield: takes 8 of your shield onto itself, and the intake hands 3 of it to the pack.
signature.capacitorWraith: Anti-charge: drains 5 charge, and if you were holding that much it swings doubled.
signature.blightVine: Anti-growth: curses a die for −3 over two turns while the root twists another every turn.
signature.bailiff: Anti-purse: bills you 6 scrap or 10 damage every cycle, steals 5 on every hit, and the writ keeps taking 6.
signature.convoyAlpha: Three escorts over one flagship: the flagship takes nothing until all three are dead, and one of them locks a die every third turn.
signature.wardenFragment: Marks land double on it, and the plate re-shields for 6 every turn: sensors are the whole fight.
signature.leechQueen: Locks a die every single turn, and calls skiffs once she is past half.
signature.mineTyrant: One new mine every turn: the field kills you, not the tyrant.
signature.choirHerald: A five-beat hymn: two charges, a slot-block and a volley, in that order, always.
signature.mirrorHull: Returns half of your last turn twice per cycle, capped at 12.
signature.dragnet: Drags your highest die into a slot of its choosing and pins it there, and the winch locks another every third turn.
signature.resonator: Hits twice per cycle for the size of your deepest school, and the coil re-plates for 6 every turn.
signature.quarantineTwin: Two synced hulls over an untouchable body: hit the same hull twice in a row and the second hit is eaten.
signature.usurer: Offers the same deal twice a cycle — 6 scrap, or 8 damage — and the vault takes 6 more on every hit.
signature.silencer: Escalates from one slot-block to two below 55% hull — and a sensor jam clears every block it holds.
signature.coreSliver: Holds one school out at a time — dice of the warded school deal half — and tells you which before it does. The facet twists a die every turn.
signature.quarantineWarden: Shields for 6 every turn while the aegis lives, and adds a slot-block below half hull.
signature.beaconTrap: A gate you cannot brute-force: hits under it are absorbed whole, it drinks the shield you raise, and below half it re-gates at 10 every phase.
signature.breakerBarge: Every hit it lands takes 6 scrap, the crane locks a die every third turn, and below 40% it opens charged.
signature.auctionCorvette: Bids on your run every cycle — pay or wear it — steals 5 on every landed hit, and doubles the bid below 45%.
signature.riftMaw: Two eyes, each twisting a die every turn; below half it also shrinks a slot cap every turn.
signature.riftBranch: Shrinks a slot cap and curses a die every cycle; below 55% the cap shrinks every single turn.
signature.choirFlagship: The spire charges the whole choir every third turn and the voice calls a new acolyte every fourth.
signature.cantorColossus: Stacks 2 onto every future hit each turn, for ever — a sensor jam is the only thing that clears the stack.
signature.coreHeart: A shell of valves over a storm: the body takes nothing while a valve lives, and the storm runs every turn from phase 2.
signature.mirrorHeart: Fights with the census of your own deck — the purer the build, the harder it hits — behind a shell of faces.
signature.retroEcho: Answers with the damage you dealt last turn, up to 14.
signature.foldWraith: Folds the resolution order for one turn — sometimes twice in a row.
signature.slowStrider: Cannot be hit while an ally lives, and gates its shield from turn 4.
signature.oddsEater: Eats your highest unplaced die and wears its value as shield.
signature.causalSplinter: Curses one of your dice when it dies, and sometimes before that.
signature.preEcho: Opens with a storm, then heals the pack if it still has one.
signature.hushHerald: Shuts two slots at once, and drains the bank if you hoard charge.
signature.paradoxLoom: Its shuttle twists a die every turn, and it mirrors your widest colour.
signature.foldTyrant: Folds the order every cycle and eats a die once the pleat gives out.
signature.hushWarden: Shuts slots, and a jam of its own emitter opens every one of them.
signature.theHush: Silences a slot every turn from the second phase; jam it to reopen them all.
signature.echoFleet: Each phase window borrows a different sector boss's signature move.

death.pact: «They will collect anyway. A contract does not care which of us is breathing.»
death.beacons: «The beacons you lit stay lit. That part of you keeps going without you.»
death.resonant: «You were almost through. One more step and the hull would not have mattered.»
death.stable: «You held the line to the last plate. I logged every second of it.»
death.alone: «Nobody out here owed you a rescue. I checked. Twice.»
death.friends: «Someone will come looking. I have the coordinates ready for them.»
death.deep: «Deeper than the last one. Deeper than the one before that. It counts.»
death.quiet: «Hull integrity zero. I am still here. For a little while.»
death.firstRun: «Your first crossing. Statistically, that is the one that ends like this.»

mara.name: Mara's ledger
mara.payoff: The book is closed, and it closed your way.
mara.betrayal: She has written you into the column she does not forgive.

step.debt: She will want the debt named before she names a favour.
step.favour: There is work she cannot give to the clan.
step.payoff: Whatever the ledger says, it settles in the last market.

yusuf.name: Yusuf and the fleet
yusuf.payoff: The procession got through, and it got through because of you.
yusuf.betrayal: He knows what you sold, and to whom.

step.convoy: Nineteen hulls need a gun on the rift side.
step.lane: The procession is stalled at a pinch you can open.

choir.name: The Choir's reading
choir.payoff: You and the hymn have an understanding, whatever shape it took.
choir.betrayal: The Choir is collecting, and it is not asking any more.

step.invite: The Preacher is broadcasting an invitation in the Rift.
step.seal: The pact wants a signature or a refusal.
step.deep: There is a deeper reading of what you signed.
step.finale: He is waiting at the last station before the Core.

keeper.name: The Keeper's thread
keeper.payoff: Five beacons, one chain, and he knows exactly who strung it.
keeper.betrayal: He has stopped routing you the easy beacons.

step.intro: Someone is still maintaining the beacons out here.
step.thread: He wants to know what you want out of this.
step.core: The last beacon is the Core, and it asks the question itself.

engines.say: Engines first. The green die is theirs — a school in its own slot always pays a bonus.
engines.fail: Engines want the green school. That is what affinity means.

shields.say: Shields take blue. A card's tint names the school that is strongest in it.
shields.fail: Shields want blue. Read the tint before you commit.

weapons.say: Weapon A. Red plus its affinity — a five leaves as a seven.
weapons.fail: Weapons want red. The card shows the sum before you drop.

sensors.say: Sensors, then the gun. Systems fire by the numbers on their cards: sensors are 1, weapons are 2, so the mark lands before the shot.
sensors.fail: Sensors take grey, and the gun still wants the red die this turn.

reactor.say: Black feeds the reactor at one and a half. A four would overflow the pool and cost two hull — nudge it down. This one is on me.
reactor.fail: The reactor is the black school's slot.

free.say: Check complete. Free turn — the board is yours.
